title: Stuck in the strange mall and can’t find way out?
content: Has anyone had this recurring dream where you’re in a mall and you can’t find an exit. And when you do, it’s the wrong parking lot and you have to go back in? Then you loop around and around and it feels ominous and very much like a different dimension? Sometimes I do make it out and then I can’t find my car. Or I’ll start walking and I can’t remember where I live. The mall has weird golden lighting mixed with arcade lighting and everyone walking around feels robotic.
